controls.title: Live content enforcement
controls.decision: Linux production enforcement uses IMA appraisal; eBPF snapshots are not accepted as proof of current file content.

controls.title: Protected scope
controls.decision: Only explicitly enrolled assets are denied on integrity failure; unrelated executables are outside DFIM enforcement.

controls.title: Fail-closed configuration
controls.decision: Missing, malformed, or unresolved policy state denies protected assets and never silently downgrades to monitor mode.

controls.title: Authenticated metadata
controls.decision: DFIMBOOT v2 must use an asymmetric signature rooted in an organizational trust anchor.

controls.title: Anti-rollback
controls.decision: A monotonic release counter must be enforced by TPM NV or an authenticated baseline registry.

controls.title: Attestation
controls.decision: TPM evidence must use a fresh nonce-bound quote; PCR extend alone is insufficient for enterprise attestation.

controls.title: Recovery
controls.decision: Every protected asset must have an authorized, tested restore path and auditable recovery evidence.

controls.title: Supply-chain provenance
controls.decision: Release artifacts require locked dependencies, policy-scanned sources and licenses, reproducible CycloneDX SBOMs, signed provenance, and verifier-enforced publisher identity.
